description: 1 long process (P1 burst=20) with 4 short processes (burst 2-3). Demonstrates RR fairness vs SJF starvation of long jobs.
key_observations: SJF will always prioritise P2-P5 over P1 once they arrive.
P1 waits until ALL short processes finish in SJF — demonstrating starvation risk.
RR gives P1 a time slice every Q=4 units — fair distribution.
SJF achieves much lower avg WT overall due to short jobs completing early.
This is the classic fairness vs efficiency trade-off.

expected_behavior.rr: P1 gets CPU every ~4 units; all processes interleaved fairly.
expected_behavior.sjf: P2, P3, P4, P5 complete first; P1 is effectively starved until they finish.
